page_title: INT 1-1 NAP | Inter v Napoli 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' What a big chance! Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Simone Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Marko Arnautovic (Inter) replaces Lautaro Martinez.
89' Today's match ends for Alessandro Bastoni who will be replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
88' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
86' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
83' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Alex Meret, who pulls off a stunning save!
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Matteo Darmian (Inter) for Federico Dimarco.
82' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Piotr Zielinski (Inter) replacing Hakan Calhanoglu.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mehdi Taremi (Inter) replaces Marcus Thuram.
82' Here is a change. Matteo Politano is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
80' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) gets a yellow card.
80' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:2.
79' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
78' Nicolo Barella (Inter) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Alex Meret was alert and the score remains the same.
77' The substitution is prepared. Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Romelu Lukaku.
75' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), whose header goes wide of the goal.
74' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post.
73' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
72' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Frank Anguissa (Napoli). Maurizio Mariani saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Inter are awarded a penalty!
71' A corner kick by Inter is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Meret (Napoli).

71' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
70' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
68' Inter take a short corner kick.

66' A pass into the box finds Federico Dimarco (Inter) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alex Meret denies him. Inter get a corner.
66' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
66' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
61' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
60' It is time for a substitution. Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is on for Billy Gilmour.
57' The current number of shots on goal is 2:2.
54' Nicolo Barella (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
54' Although Simone Inzaghi (Inter) is just on the bench, Maurizio Mariani has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
53' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.

52' Federico Dimarco (Inter) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close! The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
52' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Inter comes to nothing.
50' 58:42 – the ratio of ball possession.
49' Poor challenge! Federico Dimarco (Inter) is penalised for tripping and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle.
48' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
48' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
48' An attempted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 1 Goal! Great play by Alessandro Bastoni releases Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top right corner. 1:1.
39' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Alex Meret.
39' The fouls committed statistics – 5:4.
38' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
37' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).

36' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception. The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
36' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
35' The Inter players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
32' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
28' Nicolo Barella (Inter) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
27' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
26' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:3.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Scott McTominay (Napoli) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Amir Rrahmani. The score is 0:1.
22' Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.

21' Nicolo Barella (Inter) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and fires in from the penalty spot, but his effort zooms just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
20' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
17' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

15' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
13' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
12' The possession of the ball – 80:20.
10' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
9' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

8' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Inter have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Inter are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' The match has just started.
Inter will kick the game off.
Maurizio Mariani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
